title: First three-piece band with Arthur Campbell and Sidney Bechet
summary: His first job was upstairs at a nightclub on Gravier Alley in a trio with pianist Arthur Campbell and Sidney Bechet.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh yeah, they used to call me Little Tubby. So that's what started me to play him. So finally when I, the first band that I, it was a three piece band, a fellow by the name, Arthur Campbell, I'm a piano player, I don't know if you've ever heard of him. I've heard of him, yes. Arthur Campbell and Sidney Bechet.

And we had a three piece band down on Gidresson Alley, I mean the man around the place was Gidresson Alley, it was upstairs at the nightclub, and that's my first job with three pieces. So after I did so well, then my brother and Eddie Garland, Sugar John and a bunch of them, that's when they first went to Chicago.
